method: Screen coordinate samples from Google Maps context menu; affine conversion within each flat local view. All imagery stays private. These calibrate comparison overlays, not a metric-height survey.
height_method: Coarse visual classes, not pixel-measured elevations: low service buildings 3.5 m; ordinary two/three-storey ranges including roof envelope 7.5–12 m; tall apartment block 26 m. Uncertainty stored per block. Flat placeholder top does not represent roof pitch.
